description: pkix-revocation/src/crl.rs:163-165 — When the deltaCRLIndicator extension is present (OID found) but its INTEGER value cannot be decoded, the code returns Error::CrlParseError(der::Error::from(der::ErrorKind::Failed)). This fabricates a der::Error from ErrorKind::Failed, which is a generic 'parse failed' sentinel with no diagnostic value. The condition being detected is structural — the delta CRL has a malformed deltaCRLIndicator value — which maps more accurately to Error::CrlParseError with the real der::Error from the failed decode, or to a dedicated error. Currently the code discards the actual decode error from base_crl_number (which returns Option, not Result) and replaces it with a fabricated error. Fix: change base_crl_number to return Option<Result<u64>> or a Result, so the real DER error propagates rather than being fabricated.
title: CrlParseError used to wrap logic error in with_delta
